elements.name: Parapet_Front
elements.evidence: parapet line = OSM campus boundary (way/341105734); the gate booth's measured south face (-100.23 at x=157) lies on the same line; video 065653194 t=6/10/42 s: parapet top 0.45-0.52 m and hedge top ~1.05 m above the sidewalk, from horizon geometry (eye height 1.45 m assumed; horizon placed 60 px above the distant Block B plinth); precast concrete segments with vertical fluting, stepped at joints

elements.name: Parapet_Return
elements.evidence: assumed return from the frontage parapet to the gate-forecourt fence (Fence_West west end 135.8/-96.0)

elements.name: Hedge_Front
elements.evidence: video 065653194 t=6/10/42 s: parapet top 0.45-0.52 m and hedge top ~1.05 m above the sidewalk, from horizon geometry (eye height 1.45 m assumed; horizon placed 60 px above the distant Block B plinth); precast concrete segments with vertical fluting, stepped at joints; loose (not formally clipped) shrub hedge planted right behind the parapet

elements.name: Sidewalk_Front
elements.evidence: Google z20: perpendicular parked cars' noses at y≈-103.4 (x 137-150) -> 3.5 m from the parapet; video 065653194: clover pavers with a red-paver band
